fusions.name: Swirling Swarm
fusions.desc: Whips a swarm around you that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Stripped to the Stalk
fusions.desc: A devouring strike that deals 28 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Famine Year
fusions.desc: After a 0.3 second cast, summons a swarm that rolls along with you for 14 seconds. Twice a second it bites an enemy within 3 tiles and deals 2 damage.

fusions.name: Next Field Over
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
